name: Vampire
blurb: Twin daggers drain a third of the damage as life. Every kill raises max HP. Summons bats.

sfx.blade_hit: quick dagger stab with a wet slash
sfx.summon: flurry of bat wings and squeaks

art.floor: black and dark crimson marble checkerboard tiles with thin cracks, a uniform repeating texture with no walls
art.body: a sinister vampire: a perfectly round deep crimson ball body, a tall black high-collared cape with red lining framing it, slicked black hair with a widow's peak, glowing red eyes and two small white fangs
weapons: an ornate silver dagger with a slim blade and a crimson jeweled hilt

summons.bat: a tiny vampire bat: a round dark purple body with leathery wings spread wide, red eyes, tiny fangs

art.ultimate_icon: a black bat silhouette with spread wings in front of a red moon
art.ult_circle: a blood-red vampiric pentagram circle with bat wing shapes and gothic runes
art.ult_aura: a swirling dark crimson aura of tiny flying bats and blood mist
art.hit_fx: a dark red blood splash with tiny droplets
